scope: Conservative superficial display eligibility, not a complete anatomical visibility classifier. Excluded source surfaces remain zero-labelled occluders and keep their original inventory identities. Deep posterior forearm extensors retain their exposed distal portions. Uncertain registration stays neutral rather than expanding a deeper label.
